text.2:86: Such are those who buy the life of the world at the price of the Hereafter. Their punishment will not be lightened, neither will they have support.
text.2:162: They ever dwell therein. The doom will not be lightened for them, neither will they be reprieved.
text.3:88: They will abide therein. Their doom will not be lightened, neither will they be reprieved;
text.4:28: Allah would make the burden light for you, for man was created weak.
text.8:66: Now hath Allah lightened your burden, for He knoweth that there is weakness in you. So if there be of you a steadfast hundred they shall overcome two hundred, and if there be of you a thousand (steadfast) they shall overcome two thousand by permission of Allah. Allah is with the steadfast.
text.16:85: And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved.
text.35:36: But as for those who disbelieve, for them is fire of hell; it taketh not complete effect upon them so that they can die, nor is its torment lightened for them. Thus We punish every ingrate.
text.40:49: And those in the Fire say unto the guards of hell: Entreat your Lord that He relieve us of a day of the torment.
